title: Kitten holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- heart held by kitten -->
  <path d='M50 78 C38 68 28 60 30 50 C32 42 40 42 44 48 C46 42 54 42 56 48 C60 42 68 42 70 50 C72 60 62 68 50 78 Z' fill='#ff4060' stroke='#ff8090' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- kitten body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#ffb050' stroke='#ffd080' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- kitten head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='20' fill='#ffb850' stroke='#ffd890' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M35 30 L30 12 L44 24 Z' fill='#ffb850' stroke='#ffd890' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M65 30 L70 12 L56 24 Z' fill='#ffb850' stroke='#ffd890' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <path d='M36 28 L33 17 L43 25 Z' fill='#ff8090'/>
  <path d='M64 28 L67 17 L57 25 Z' fill='#ff8090'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='44' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3050a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='44' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3050a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='42' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#c0e0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='42' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#c0e0ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M48 50 L52 50 L50 53 Z' fill='#ff6080'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 53 Q47 56 45 54' stroke='#a06020' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 53 Q53 56 55 54' stroke='#a06020' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='47' x2='38' y2='49' stroke='#ffe0b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='52' x2='38' y2='52' stroke='#ffe0b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='47' x2='62' y2='49' stroke='#ffe0b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='52' x2='62' y2='52' stroke='#ffe0b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='68' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ffc870' stroke='#ffe0a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='68' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ffc870' stroke='#ffe0a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- paw toe lines -->
  <line x1='35' y1='68' x2='35' y2='72' stroke='#e09040' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='68' x2='40' y2='72' stroke='#e09040' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='68' x2='60' y2='72' stroke='#e09040' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='68' x2='65' y2='72' stroke='#e09040' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- kitten tail -->
  <path d='M68 76 Q82 80 80 68 Q79 62 74 64' stroke='#ffb850' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 76 Q82 80 80 68 Q79 62 74 64' stroke='#ffd890' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tabby stripes on forehead -->
  <path d='M44 32 Q50 28 56 32' stroke='#e09040' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 36 Q50 33 54 36' stroke='#e09040' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ff90a0' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
